title: Alma Teaches Privately
summary: After fleeing king Noah’s servants and repenting, Alma privately teaches willing listeners the words of Abinadi. He teaches about what is to come, resurrection, and redemption through Christ. Many believe his words.

explicit_facts.text: Alma fled from the servants of king Noah and repented of his sins and iniquities.
Alma went about privately among the people and began teaching the words of Abinadi.
His teachings concerned what was to come, the resurrection of the dead, and redemption through the power, sufferings, death, resurrection, and ascension of Christ.
Alma taught those who would hear him privately so the king would not learn of it; many believed his words.

unspecified_visual_details: The exact setting, time of day, clothing, and appearances of Alma and his listeners.

narration.text: And now, it came to pass that Alma, who had fled from the servants of king Noah, repented of his sins and iniquities, and went about privately among the people, and began to teach the words of Abinadi—
And many did believe his words.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The content of Alma’s teaching is reported by the narrator, Mormon, not supplied as verbatim speech.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent dialogue for Alma or the listeners.

Do not place Abinadi or king Noah physically among the listeners.
